_comment: Cosplay/party kiosk config for google/nano-banana-2. 'image' mode themes (singapore_ghost, fries) pair the user's photo with a costume reference_image under imgs/cosplay/. 'prompt' mode themes (fantasy_halloween) use only the character's descriptive prompt text on the user's own photo. Server prepends a shared identity-preservation guard to every character before calling the model.
identity_guard: Keep the exact face, facial features, skin tone, and identity of the person in the photo completely unchanged — do not alter their face in any way. Only change their clothing, costume, hair styling, and add the described props or accessories. Do not add any other people, text, watermarks, or logos.
image_mode_instruction: This is a complete clothing and costume reference edit. Apply the full outfit, costume pieces, and accessories shown in the second reference image to the person in the first photo — same garments, same colors, same materials. Frame in a full-body or three-quarter view showing the entire costume from top to bottom, completely visible without cropping or cutting off any part of the costume. Only the costume changes; the person's face, skin tone, and identity stay the same.
image_mode_instruction_retry: Edit the photo so the person is wearing the complete full outfit shown in the reference image. Show the entire costume from top to bottom in a full three-quarter or full-body view without cropping.
harmonize_prompt: Blend everyone in this photo into one cohesive, naturally-posed group scene: unify the lighting direction, color grading, and shadow softness across all people and the background so it looks like one naturally photographed group photo. You may adjust each person's pose, stance, and body angle so the group looks like they are standing together naturally — angled slightly toward each other, sharing the same ground plane and perspective — instead of independently posed cutouts. Keep everyone fully visible and inside the frame: do not crop, cut off, or trim any part of any person, and keep the whole group centred within the frame with even space on both sides, not pushed to one edge. Do not change any person's face, costume, or identity. Do not add or remove anyone. Do not add any text or watermarks.
harmonize_prompt_single: Blend this person naturally into the background scene: unify the lighting direction, color grading, and shadow softness between the person and the background so it looks like one naturally photographed scene, as if they were truly standing there. Keep the person fully visible and inside the frame: do not crop, cut off, or trim any part of them, and keep them centred within the frame with even space on both sides. Keep the original expression of the person. Do not change their face, costume, pose, or identity. This photo has exactly one person — do not add any other people, figures, or reflections of additional people. Do not add any text or watermarks.
